description: Type a missing device invite as DeviceInviteNotFound. getDeviceInvite and deleteDeviceInvite answer a deleted or unknown invite with 400 'invalid invite' (sometimes prefixed '[unexpected]: '), not the declared 404 (live, 2026-10-03).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The device invite does not exist: it was deleted, its device was deleted, or the ID is malformed (Tailscale answers HTTP 400 with `invalid invite`).
